title: Can I BEAT Pac-Man Chess?
summary: chess.com 4-player community variant Pac Chess on a 14x14 maze: Red (you) and Yellow each have only Bob, a royal wazir that survives three checks; capturing blue pellets scores (dabbaba +1, general +5), checkmate +10; Green's ghosts (2 pawns, 2 rooks in the ghost house) are a bot playing 50% attacking / 50% random moves and can never be captured; most points when a Bob is mated wins, and the survivor takes the points still on the board. 3+2. Four games (3 wins as Red, 1 loss as Yellow) then a bonus real Pac-Man game.
rules: 14x14 board with 3x3 corners cut; grey stone walls (still maxres1).
Red and Yellow each start with one piece: Bob, a royal wazir with a 3-check counter (0:03; badge '3'; 6:00 'only has one check left').
Capturing blue pieces scores: dabbaba +1, general +5; checkmate +10 (0:10, 2:03).
Green: 2 pawns + 2 rooks in the ghost house, moved by a bot with 50% attacking / 50% random moves; green pieces can never be captured (0:17-0:26).
Goal: most points before either player is checkmated; if you are captured by green, the remaining points go to the opponent (0:28-0:35, 4:56).
win_condition: Most points when a Bob is checkmated / captured / out of checks.
